proposed_concrete: MEM-CSPAN-003 (proposed): automated operation span with per-set feedback (Unsworth et al. 2005, doi:10.3758/BF03192720)
reason: Currently a variant of MEM-CSPAN-002. The automated version gives feedback on recall and equation accuracy after each set and uses letters instead of words; if the 1989 procedure had no feedback, criterion 4 (feedback mode) applies and a separate serial number is warranted. Needs the full text of Turner & Engle 1989 to decide.

proposed_concrete: PER-CROWD-002 (proposed): vernier crowding with equal- vs longer-length flankers, high-density EEG (Chicherov et al. 2014, doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2014.02.021)
reason: Currently a variant of PER-CROWD-001. Target type changes from letter identification to vernier offset discrimination and the flanker manipulation contrasts grouping (equal vs longer flankers); maintainer to decide whether this is criterion 2 (stimulus type).

proposed_concrete: CTL-NUM-003 (proposed): comparison of single numbers with a fixed standard (larger/smaller than 5), ERP (Dehaene 1996, doi:10.1162/jocn.1996.8.1.47)
reason: Currently a variant of CTL-NUM-001. One number at a time against a memorised standard instead of two numbers side by side; maintainer to decide whether this is criterion 2 (stimulus type).

proposed_concrete: No new concrete paradigm: first_source of PER-ODD-008 (auditory spatial P300 BCI, AMUSE) could be moved to Schreuder, Blankertz & Tangermann 2010 (doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0009813)
reason: Found while checking PER-AUDLOC for duplicates. The 2010 PLoS ONE paper (Crossref record) introduces the spatial-hearing multi-class auditory BCI and predates the current first_source (Schreuder et al. 2011, Front Neurosci). For the owner of PER-ODD-008 (package A).
